name: ALVIMOPAN
indications_original: Alvimopan capsules are indicated to accelerate the time to upper and lower gastrointestinal recovery following surgeries that include partial bowel resection with primary anastomosis.
contraindications_original:
For hospital use only. The recommended adult dosage of alvimopan capsules is 12 mg administered 30 minutes to 5 hours prior to surgery followed by 12 mg twice daily beginning the day after surgery until discharge for a maximum of 7 days. Patients should not receive more than 15 doses of alvimopan capsules.
                  Alvimopan capsules can be taken with or without food [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)].
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Alvimopan capsules, 12 mg, are hard gelatin capsules having blue opaque color cap imprinted with “PAR” and “3012” in black ink & blue opaque color body imprinted with “PAR” and “3012” in black ink. Alvimopan capsules are for hospital use only. They are supplied as follows
                  Carton containing 30 (6 x 5) unit-dose capsules                      NDC 0254-3012-55
                  Store at 25°C (77°F); excursions permitted to 15° to 30°C (59° to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
adverseReactions_original: Alvimopan capsules are contraindicated in patients who have taken therapeutic doses of opioids for more than 7 consecutive days immediately prior to taking alvimopan capsules [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)].
